detaileddescription.para: GetOperands fills a vector of material property matrices with the required values for later computation. These matrices always have the dimensions spatial-dimension^2 and they will hold either scalar, vector or tensor properties, depending on what kind of property the Operand is.
When the property is an element property, it will be put into the first vector entry MTRL[0].
